description: This Java class 'ContentRepositoryUtils' provides utility functions related to image processing within a content repository. It includes enums for image MIME types, file extensions, and data URI suffixes, as well as methods for validating image types, extracting images from data URLs, validating file sizes, checking for empty image parameters, and generating random strings for identifiers.

classes.name: ContentRepositoryUtils
classes.description: Utility class for handling image and file validations, extractions, and random string generation within a content repository context.

methods.name: imageExtensionFromFileName
methods.description: Determines the image file extension based on the filename suffix.

methods.name: validateImageMimeType
methods.description: Checks if the provided MIME type is one of the known image types (GIF, JPEG, PNG).

methods.name: extractImageFromDataURL
methods.description: Extracts the base64-encoded image data and its extension from a data URL string.

methods.name: validateFileSizeWithinPermissibleRange
methods.description: Validates that the file size is within the maximum upload size limit.

methods.name: validateClientImageNotEmpty
methods.description: Ensures the provided image file name parameter is not null or empty.

methods.name: generateRandomString
methods.description: Generates a random string of characters (length between 5 and 16) for identifiers.
